    97→}
    98→
    99→
   100→def _render_cluster_item(item: dict) -> None:
   101→    """Render an auto-cluster task card."""
   102→    member_count = int(item.get("member_count", 0))
   103→    action_type = item.get("action_type", "manual_fix")
   104→    cluster_name = item.get("id", "")
   105→    if cluster_name == "auto/initial-review":
   106→        type_label = "Initial subjective review"
   107→    elif cluster_name == "auto/stale-review":
   108→        type_label = "Stale subjective review"
   109→    else:
   110→        type_label = _ACTION_TYPE_LABELS.get(action_type, "Grouped task")
   111→    print(colorize(f"  ({type_label}, {member_count} findings)", "bold"))
   112→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
   113→    print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
   114→
   115→    # Show breakdown by file (compact) + representative members
   116→    members = item.get("members", [])
   117→    if members:
   118→        # File distribution
   119→        from collections import Counter
   120→        file_counts = Counter(m.get("file", "?") for m in members)
   121→        if len(file_counts) <= 5:
   122→            print(colorize("\n  Files:", "dim"))
   123→            for f, c in file_counts.most_common():
   124→                print(f"    {f} ({c})")
   125→        else:
   126→            print(colorize(f"\n  Spread across {len(file_counts)} files:", "dim"))
   127→            for f, c in file_counts.most_common(3):
   128→                print(f"    {f} ({c})")
   129→            remaining = len(file_counts) - 3
   130→            print(colorize(f"    ... and {remaining} more files", "dim"))
   131→
   132→        # Sample IDs
   133→        print(colorize("\n  Sample:", "dim"))
   134→        for m in members[:3]:
   135→            print(f"    - {m.get('id', '')}")
   136→        if len(members) > 3:
   137→            print(colorize(f"    ... and {len(members) - 3} more", "dim"))
   138→
   139→    # Action
   140→    cluster_name = item.get("id", "")
   141→    primary_command = item.get("primary_command")
   142→    if primary_command:
   143→        print(colorize(f"\n  Action: {primary_command}", "cyan"))
   144→
   145→    # Resolution hints
   146→    print(colorize(f'\n  Resolve all:   desloppify plan done "{cluster_name}" '
   147→                   f'--note "<what>" --attest "{ATTEST_EXAMPLE}"', "dim"))
   148→    print(colorize(f"  Drill in:      desloppify next --cluster {cluster_name} --count 10",
   149→                   "dim"))
   150→    print(colorize(f"  Skip cluster:  desloppify plan skip {cluster_name}", "dim"))
   151→
   152→
   153→def _render_item(
   154→    item: dict, dim_scores: dict, findings_scoped: dict, explain: bool,
   155→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   156→) -> None:
   157→    # Delegate to cluster renderer for cluster meta-items
   158→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
   159→        _render_cluster_item(item)
   160→        return
   161→
   162→    tier = int(item.get("effective_tier", item.get("tier", 3)))
   163→    confidence = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   164→    print(colorize(f"  (Tier {tier}, {confidence} confidence)", "bold"))
   165→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
   166→    print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
   167→
   168→    # Effort/type label
   169→    if item.get("detector") == "review":
   170→        print(colorize("  Type: Design review (requires judgment)", "dim"))
   171→    elif is_auto_fix_command(item.get("primary_command")):
   172→        print(colorize("  Type: Auto-fixable", "dim"))
   173→
   174→    kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
   175→    if kind == "subjective_dimension":
   176→        detail = item.get("detail", {})
   177→        subjective_score = float(
   178→            detail.get("strict_score", item.get("subjective_score", 100.0))
   179→        )
   180→        print(f"  Dimension: {detail.get('dimension_name', 'unknown')}")
   181→        print(f"  Score: {subjective_score:.1f}% (always queued as T4)")
   182→        print(
   183→            colorize(
   184→                f"  Action: {item.get('primary_command', 'desloppify review --prepare')}",
   185→                "cyan",
   186→            )
   187→        )
   188→        print(colorize(
   189→            "  Note: re-review scores what it finds — scores can go down if issues are discovered.",
   190→            "dim",
   191→        ))
   192→        if explain:
   193→            reason = item.get("explain", {}).get(
   194→                "policy",
   195→                "subjective items are fixed at T4 and do not outrank mechanical T1/T2/T3.",
   196→            )
   197→            print(colorize(f"  explain: {reason}", "dim"))
   198→        return
   199→
   200→    # Plan overrides: description, cluster, note
   201→    if item.get("plan_description"):
   202→        print(colorize(f"  → {item['plan_description']}", "cyan"))
   203→    plan_cluster = item.get("plan_cluster")
   204→    if isinstance(plan_cluster, dict):
   205→        cluster_name = plan_cluster.get("name", "")
   206→        cluster_desc = plan_cluster.get("description") or ""
   207→        total = plan_cluster.get("total_items", 0)
   208→        desc_str = f' — "{cluster_desc}"' if cluster_desc else ""
   209→        print(colorize(f"  Cluster: {cluster_name}{desc_str} ({total} items)", "dim"))
   210→    if item.get("plan_note"):
   211→        print(colorize(f"  Note: {item['plan_note']}", "dim"))
   212→
   213→    file = item.get("file", "")
   214→    if file and file != ".":
   215→        print(f"  File: {file}")
   216→    print(colorize(f"  ID:   {item.get('id', '')}", "dim"))
   217→
   218→    detail = item.get("detail", {})
   219→    if detail.get("lines"):
   220→        print(f"  Lines: {', '.join(str(line_no) for line_no in detail['lines'][:8])}")
   221→    if detail.get("category"):
   222→        print(f"  Category: {detail['category']}")
   223→    if detail.get("importers") is not None:
   224→        print(f"  Active importers: {detail['importers']}")
   225→    if detail.get("suggestion"):
   226→        print(colorize(f"\n  Suggestion: {detail['suggestion']}", "dim"))
   227→
   228→    target_line = detail.get("line") or (detail.get("lines", [None]) or [None])[0]
   229→    if target_line and item.get("file") not in (".", ""):
   230→        snippet = read_code_snippet(item["file"], target_line)
   231→        if snippet:
   232→            print(colorize("\n  Code:", "dim"))
   233→            print(snippet)
   234→
   235→    if dim_scores:
   236→        detector = item.get("detector", "")
   237→        dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   238→        if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   239→            dimension_score = dim_scores[dimension.name]
   240→            strict_val = dimension_score.get("strict", dimension_score["score"])
   241→            print(
   242→                colorize(
   243→                    f"\n  Dimension: {dimension.name} — {dimension_score['score']:.1f}% "
   244→                    f"(strict: {strict_val:.1f}%) "
   245→                    f"({dimension_score['issues']} of {dimension_score['checks']:,} checks failing)",
   246→                    "dim",
   247→                )
   248→            )
   249→
   250→    # Score impact estimate
   251→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
   252→    if potentials and detector and dim_scores:
   253→        try:
   254→            from desloppify.scoring import compute_score_impact
   255→            impact = compute_score_impact(dim_scores, potentials, detector, issues_to_fix=1)
   256→            if impact > 0:
   257→                print(colorize(f"  Impact: fixing this is worth ~+{impact:.1f} pts on overall score", "cyan"))
   258→            else:
   259→                # Single-item impact rounds to 0 — try bulk impact for all issues in detector
   260→                dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   261→                if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   262→                    issues = dim_scores[dimension.name].get("issues", 0)
   263→                    if issues > 1:
   264→                        bulk = compute_score_impact(dim_scores, potentials, detector, issues_to_fix=issues)
   265→                        if bulk > 0:
   266→                            print(colorize(
   267→                                f"  Impact: fixing all {issues} {detector} issues → ~+{bulk:.1f} pts",
   268→                                "cyan",
   269→                            ))
   270→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError):
   271→            pass
   272→    elif detector == "review" and dim_scores:
   273→        # Review findings: show dimension drag from breakdown
   274→        try:
   275→            from desloppify.scoring import compute_health_breakdown
   276→            dim_key = item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")
   277→            if dim_key:
   278→                breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   279→                for entry in breakdown.get("entries", []):
   280→                    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   281→                        continue
   282→                    entry_key = str(entry.get("name", "")).lower().replace(" ", "_")
   283→                    if entry_key == dim_key.lower().replace(" ", "_"):
   284→                        drag = float(entry.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   285→                        if drag > 0.01:
   286→                            print(colorize(
   287→                                f"  Dimension drag: {entry['name']} costs -{drag:.2f} pts on overall score",
   288→                                "cyan",
   289→                            ))
   290→                        break
   291→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError):
   292→            pass
   293→
   294→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   295→    auto_fix_command = item.get("primary_command")
   296→    if is_auto_fix_command(auto_fix_command):
   297→        similar_count = sum(
   298→            1
   299→            for finding in findings_scoped.values()
   300→            if finding.get("detector") == detector_name and finding["status"] == "open"
   301→        )
   302→        if similar_count > 1:
   303→            print(
   304→                colorize(
   305→                    f"\n  Auto-fixable: {similar_count} similar findings. "
   306→                    f"Run `{auto_fix_command}` to fix all at once.",
   307→                    "cyan",
   308→                )
   309→            )
   310→    if explain:
   311→        explanation = item.get("explain", {})
   312→        count_weight = explanation.get("count", int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0))
   313→        base = (
   314→            f"ranked by tier={tier}, confidence={confidence}, "
   315→            f"count={count_weight}, id={item.get('id', '')}"
   316→        )
   317→
   318→        # Add dimension context for mechanical detectors
   319→        if dim_scores and detector:
   320→            dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   321→            if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   322→                ds = dim_scores[dimension.name]
   323→                base += (
   324→                    f". Dimension: {dimension.name} at {ds['score']:.1f}% "
   325→                    f"({ds['issues']} open issues)"
   326→                )
   327→
   328→        # For review findings, show subjective dimension context
   329→        if item.get("detector") == "review" and dim_scores:
   330→            dim_key = item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")
   331→            if dim_key:
   332→                for ds_name, ds_data in dim_scores.items():
   333→                    if ds_name.lower().replace(" ", "_") == dim_key.lower().replace(" ", "_"):
   334→                        score_val = ds_data.get("score", "?")
   335→                        score_str = f"{score_val:.1f}" if isinstance(score_val, (int, float)) else str(score_val)
   336→                        base += f". Subjective dimension: {ds_name} at {score_str}%"
   337→                        break
   338→
   339→        policy = explanation.get("policy")
   340→        if policy:
   341→            base = f"{base}. {policy}"
   342→        print(colorize(f"  explain: {base}", "dim"))
   343→

   387→def _render_synthesis_item(item: dict) -> None:
   388→    """Render the synthesis::pending card."""

   390→    total = detail.get("total_review_findings", 0)
   391→    new = detail.get("new_since_last", 0)
   392→    resolved = detail.get("resolved_since_last", 0)
   393→    trigger = detail.get("trigger", "unknown")
   394→    epic_count = detail.get("epic_count", 0)
   395→    pending = detail.get("pending_epics", 0)
   396→    in_prog = detail.get("in_progress_epics", 0)
   397→    completed = detail.get("completed_epics", 0)
   398→
   399→    print(colorize("  PLAN — do not proceed until complete", "bold"))
   400→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
   401→    print(f"  {total} review findings need integration into the meta-plan.")
   402→    print(f"  Trigger: {trigger}")
   403→    print()
   404→    if new:
   405→        print(f"  New findings since last synthesis: {new}")
   406→    if resolved:
   407→        print(f"  Resolved since last synthesis: {resolved}")
   408→    if epic_count:
   409→        print(f"  Current epics: {epic_count} ({pending} pending, {in_prog} in progress, {completed} completed)")
   410→    print()
   411→    print(colorize("  This is a planning step. Do NOT start fixing code until this is done.", "yellow"))
   412→    print()
   413→    print("  Steps:")
   414→    print("    1. Run `desloppify plan synthesize` to see all review findings")
   415→    print("    2. Analyze findings — group by root cause into clusters")
   416→    print("    3. Create clusters, set priorities, focus on first arc")
   417→    print('    4. Mark complete: `desloppify plan done synthesis::pending --note "..." --attest "..."`')
   418→    print("    5. THEN run `desloppify next` for implementation tasks")
   419→    print()
   420→    print("  Preview:  desloppify plan synthesize --dry-run")
   421→    print()
   422→    print("  View plan:")
   423→    print("    desloppify plan queue              — see all items in priority order")
   424→    print("    desloppify plan show               — plan status summary")

   427→def _render_epic_item(item: dict) -> None:
   428→    """Render an epic card."""
   429→    detail = item.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(item.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   430→    direction = detail.get("direction", "")
   431→    thesis = detail.get("thesis", "")
   432→    root_cause = detail.get("root_cause", "")
   433→    status = detail.get("epic_status", "pending")
   434→    agent_safe = detail.get("agent_safe", False)
   435→    dep_order = detail.get("dependency_order", 999)
   436→    total_epics = detail.get("total_epics", 0)
   437→    finding_ids = detail.get("finding_ids", [])
   438→    action_steps = detail.get("action_steps", [])
   439→
   440→    safe_tag = " agent-safe" if agent_safe else ""
   441→    print(colorize(f"  [Epic — {direction}] ({len(finding_ids)} findings,{safe_tag} dependency_order: {dep_order})", "bold"))
   442→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
   443→    print(f"  Thesis: {thesis}")
   444→    if root_cause:
   445→        print(f"  Root cause: {root_cause}")
   446→    print(f"  Status: {status}")
   447→    if total_epics:
   448→        print(f"  This is part of the meta-plan (epic {dep_order} of {total_epics}).")
   449→    print()
   450→    if action_steps:
   451→        print("  Steps:")
   452→        for i, step in enumerate(action_steps, 1):
   453→            print(f"    {i}. {step}")
   454→        print()
   455→    if finding_ids:
   456→        shown = finding_ids[:5]
   457→        print("  Findings in this epic:")
   458→        for fid in shown:
   459→            print(f"    - {fid}")
   460→        if len(finding_ids) > 5:
   461→            print(f"    ... and {len(finding_ids) - 5} more")
   462→        print()
   463→    epic_name = item.get("id", "")
   464→    print(f"  Work on this epic:")
   465→    print(f"    desloppify plan focus {epic_name}")
   466→    print(f"    (then work through findings with desloppify next)")

   469→def render_terminal_items(
   470→    items: list[dict],
   471→    dim_scores: dict,
   472→    findings_scoped: dict,
   473→    *,
   474→    group: str,
   475→    explain: bool,
   476→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   477→    plan: dict | None = None,
   478→) -> None:
   479→    # Show strategy summary when epics exist
   480→    _render_strategy_summary(plan)
   481→
   482→    # Show focus header if plan has active cluster
   483→    if plan and plan.get("active_cluster"):
   484→        cluster_name = plan["active_cluster"]
   485→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   486→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   487→        total = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   488→        visible = sum(1 for it in items if it.get("kind") != "synthesis_needed")
   489→        print(colorize(f"\n  Focused on: {cluster_name} ({visible} of {total} remaining)", "cyan"))
   490→
   491→        # Exclude the synthesis item from the focus count — it's a queue-level
   492→        # blocker, not a cluster member, so don't count it in "N of M remaining".
   493→        focus_items = [it for it in items if it.get("kind") != "synthesis_needed"]
   494→        if len(focus_items) == 0:
   495→            print(colorize(
   496→                "  This cluster has no remaining items. "
   497→                "Run `desloppify plan focus --clear` to unfocus, "
   498→                "or `desloppify plan cluster show` to inspect.",
   499→                "yellow",
   500→            ))
   501→
   502→    # When synthesis is pending, only show the planning card — don't leak
   503→    # implementation tasks that would tempt agents to skip the planning step.
   504→    if items and items[0].get("kind") == "synthesis_needed":
   505→        queue_pos = items[0].get("queue_position")
   506→        pos_str = f"  (#{queue_pos} in queue)" if queue_pos else ""
   507→        print(colorize(f"  Next item{pos_str}", "bold"))
   508→        _render_synthesis_item(items[0])
   509→        return
   510→
   511→    if group != "item":
   512→        _render_grouped(items, group)
   513→        return
   514→    for idx, item in enumerate(items):
   515→        if idx > 0:
   516→            print()
   517→        kind = item.get("kind", "")
   518→        queue_pos = item.get("queue_position")
   519→
   520→        # All item types get the same position label — no visual hierarchy
   521→        # that makes synthetic items look like metadata instead of tasks.
   522→        if queue_pos and len(items) > 1:
   523→            label = f"  [#{queue_pos}]"
   524→        elif len(items) > 1:
   525→            label = f"  [{idx + 1}/{len(items)}]"
   526→        else:
   527→            pos_str = f"  (#{ queue_pos} in queue)" if queue_pos else ""
   528→            label = f"  Next item{pos_str}"
   529→        print(colorize(label, "bold"))
   530→
   531→        if kind == "epic":
   532→            _render_epic_item(item)
   533→            continue
   534→        _render_item(item, dim_scores, findings_scoped, explain=explain, potentials=potentials)
   535→
   536→
   537→def render_single_item_resolution_hint(items: list[dict]) -> None:
   538→    if len(items) != 1:
   539→        return
   540→    kind = items[0].get("kind", "")
   541→    if kind in ("cluster", "synthesis_needed", "epic"):
   542→        return  # These cards include their own resolution hints
   543→    if kind != "finding":
   544→        return
   545→    item = items[0]
   546→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   547→    if detector_name == "subjective_review":
   548→        print(colorize("\n  Review with:", "dim"))
   549→        primary = item.get(
   550→            "primary_command", "desloppify show subjective"
   551→        )
   552→        print(f"    {primary}")
   553→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(item):
   554→            print("    desloppify review --prepare")
   555→        return
   556→
   557→    primary = item.get("primary_command", "")
   558→    if is_auto_fix_command(primary):
   559→        print(colorize("\n  Fix with:", "dim"))
   560→        print(f"    {primary}")
   561→        print(colorize("  Or resolve individually:", "dim"))
   562→    else:
   563→        print(colorize("\n  Resolve with:", "dim"))
   564→
   565→    print(
   566→        f'    desloppify plan done "{item["id"]}" --note "<what you did>" '
   567→        f'--attest "{ATTEST_EXAMPLE}"'
   568→    )
   569→    print(
   570→        f'    desloppify plan skip --permanent "{item["id"]}" --note "<why>" '
   571→        f'--attest "{ATTEST_EXAMPLE}"'
   572→    )

   575→def render_followup_nudges(
   576→    state: dict,
   577→    dim_scores: dict,
   578→    findings_scoped: dict,
   579→    *,
   580→    strict_score: float | None,
   581→    target_strict_score: float,
   582→) -> None:
   583→    subjective_threshold = target_strict_score
   584→    subjective_entries = scorecard_subjective(state, dim_scores)
   585→    followup = build_subjective_followup(
   586→        state,
   587→        subjective_entries,
   588→        threshold=subjective_threshold,
   589→        max_quality_items=3,
   590→        max_integrity_items=5,
   591→    )
   592→    unassessed_subjective = unassessed_subjective_dimensions(dim_scores)
   593→    if strict_score is not None:
   594→        gap = round(float(target_strict_score) - float(strict_score), 1)
   595→        if gap > 0:
   596→            print(
   597→                colorize(

    14→def _truncate(text: str, width: int) -> str:

    20→def _cluster_tier_label(item: dict) -> str:
    21→    """Compute a tier label from cluster members, e.g. 'T2' or 'T1-T3'."""
    22→    members = item.get("members", [])
    23→    if not members:
    24→        return ""
    25→    tiers = {int(m.get("effective_tier", m.get("tier", 3))) for m in members}
    26→    lo, hi = min(tiers), max(tiers)
    27→    if lo == hi:
    28→        return f"T{lo}"
    29→    return f"T{lo}-T{hi}"

    40→    for finding_id, finding in scoped.items():
    41→        if finding.get("suppressed"):
    42→            continue
    43→        if not status_matches(finding.get("status", "open"), status_filter):
    44→            continue

    52→        item["kind"] = "finding"
    53→        item["is_review"] = is_review_finding(item)
    54→        item["is_subjective"] = is_subjective_finding(item)
    55→        item["effective_tier"] = (
    56→            4 if item["is_subjective"] else int(finding.get("tier", 3))
    57→        )
    58→        item["review_weight"] = (
    59→            review_finding_weight(item) if item["is_review"] else None
    60→        )
    61→        subjective_score = None
    62→        if item["is_subjective"]:
    63→            detail = detail_dict(finding)
    64→            dim_name = detail.get("dimension_name", "")
    65→            dim_key = detail.get("dimension", "") or slugify(dim_name)
    66→            subjective_score = subjective_scores.get(

    68→            )
    69→        item["subjective_score"] = subjective_score
    70→        supported_fixers = supported_fixers_for_item(state, item)
    71→        item["primary_command"] = primary_command_for_finding(

    76→        if not scope_matches(item, scope):

    78→        out.append(item)

    80→    return out
    81→
    82→
    83→_CLUSTER_ACTION_PRIORITY = {"auto_fix": 0, "reorganize": 1, "refactor": 2, "manual_fix": 3}
    84→

    86→def item_sort_key(item: dict) -> tuple:
    87→    kind = item.get("kind", "")
    88→
    89→    # Synthesis and epic items sort before everything else (T0-equivalent).
    90→    if kind == "synthesis_needed":
    91→        return (-2, 0, 0, item.get("id", ""))

    97→        return (-1, dep_order, 0, item.get("id", ""))
    98→
    99→    if kind == "cluster":
   100→        # Clusters sort before individual findings, ordered by action type
   101→        # (auto_fix first, then reorganize, refactor, manual_fix),
   102→        # then bigger clusters first within the same action type.
   103→        action_pri = _CLUSTER_ACTION_PRIORITY.get(

   106→        return (

   108→            action_pri,

   111→        )
   112→
   113→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" or item.get("is_subjective"):
   114→        return (

   116→            1,  # Subjective items sort after mechanical items within T4.
   117→            subjective_score_value(item),
   118→            item.get("id", ""),
   119→        )
   120→
   121→    detail = detail_dict(item)
   122→    review_weight = float(item.get("review_weight", 0.0) or 0.0)
   123→    return (

   125→        0,
   126→        CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(item.get("confidence", "low"), 9),
   127→        -review_weight,
   128→        -int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0),
   129→        item.get("id", ""),
   130→    )
   131→
   132→

   134→    effective_tier = int(item.get("effective_tier", item.get("tier", 3)))
   135→
   136→    if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension":
   137→        return {

   155→    elif is_review:

   160→            "count desc",

   162→        ]
   163→    else:

   165→    explain = {

   196→    return counts

     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from dataclasses import dataclass
     6→from typing import TypedDict
     7→
     8→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import (

    26→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    27→class QueueBuildOptions:
    28→    """Configuration for queue construction and tier selection behavior."""
    29→
    30→    tier: int | None = None
    31→    count: int | None = 1
    32→    scan_path: str | None = None
    33→    scope: str | None = None
    34→    status: str = "open"

    45→
    46→class WorkQueueResult(TypedDict):
    47→    """Typed shape of the dict returned by :func:`build_work_queue`."""
    48→
    49→    items: list[dict]
    50→    total: int
    51→    tier_counts: dict[int, int]
    52→    requested_tier: int | None
    53→    selected_tier: int | None
    54→    fallback_reason: str | None
    55→    available_tiers: list[int]
    56→    grouped: dict[str, list[dict]]
    57→
    58→
    59→def _apply_plan_order(
    60→    items: list[dict],
    61→    plan: dict,
    62→    *,
    63→    include_skipped: bool = False,
    64→    cluster: str | None = None,
    65→    state: dict | None = None,
    66→) -> list[dict]:
    67→    """Reorder items according to the living plan.
    68→
    69→    1. Items in ``queue_order`` appear first, in that order.
    70→    2. Remaining items keep their mechanical sort.
    71→    3. Skipped items are appended last (or excluded).
    72→    4. Each item is annotated with plan metadata.
    73→    """
    74→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    75→    skipped_map: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
    76→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
    77→    overrides: dict = plan.get("overrides", {})
    78→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
    79→    active_cluster = plan.get("active_cluster")
    80→
    81→    # Build lookup
    82→    by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
    83→    for item in items:
    84→        by_id[item["id"]] = item
    85→
    86→    # Build synthetic items for skipped entries missing from the work queue
    87→    if include_skipped and state:
    88→        findings = state.get("findings", {})
    89→        for fid in skipped_ids:
    90→            if fid not in by_id and fid in findings:
    91→                f = findings[fid]
    92→                by_id[fid] = {
    93→                    "id": fid,
    94→                    "kind": "finding",
    95→                    "tier": f.get("tier", 3),
    96→                    "effective_tier": f.get("tier", 3),
    97→                    "confidence": f.get("confidence", "medium"),
    98→                    "detector": f.get("detector", ""),
    99→                    "file": f.get("file", ""),
   100→                    "summary": f.get("summary", ""),
   101→                    "status": f.get("status", "open"),
   102→                }
   103→
   104→    # Annotate items with plan metadata
   105→    for item_id, item in by_id.items():
   106→        override = overrides.get(item_id, {})
   107→        if override.get("description"):
   108→            item["plan_description"] = override["description"]
   109→        if override.get("note"):
   110→            item["plan_note"] = override["note"]
   111→        if override.get("cluster"):
   112→            cluster_name = override["cluster"]
   113→            cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   114→            item["plan_cluster"] = {
   115→                "name": cluster_name,
   116→                "description": cluster_data.get("description"),
   117→                "total_items": len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", [])),
   118→                "sibling_ids": cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []),
   119→            }
   120→
   121→    # Split into ordered, remaining, skipped
   122→    ordered: list[dict] = []
   123→    ordered_ids: set[str] = set()
   124→    for fid in queue_order:
   125→        if fid in by_id and fid not in skipped_ids:
   126→            ordered.append(by_id[fid])
   127→            ordered_ids.add(fid)
   128→
   129→    skipped_items: list[dict] = []
   130→    remaining: list[dict] = []
   131→    for item in items:
   132→        item_id = item["id"]
   133→        if item_id in ordered_ids:
   134→            continue
   135→        if item_id in skipped_ids:
   136→            skipped_items.append(item)
   137→        else:
   138→            remaining.append(item)
   139→
   140→    # Assign queue positions
   141→    result = ordered + remaining
   142→    if include_skipped:
   143→        result = result + skipped_items
   144→
   145→    for pos, item in enumerate(result):
   146→        item["queue_position"] = pos + 1
   147→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   148→            item["plan_skipped"] = True
   149→            skip_entry = skipped_map.get(item["id"])
   150→            if skip_entry:
   151→                item["plan_skip_kind"] = skip_entry.get("kind", "temporary")
   152→                skip_reason = skip_entry.get("reason")
   153→                if skip_reason:
   154→                    item["plan_skip_reason"] = skip_reason
   155→
   156→    # Filter to cluster if requested — but never filter out synthesis items;
   157→    # they are queue-level blockers that outrank cluster membership.
   158→    effective_cluster = cluster or active_cluster
   159→    if effective_cluster:
   160→        cluster_data = clusters.get(effective_cluster, {})
   161→        cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   162→        result = [
   163→            item for item in result
   164→            if item["id"] in cluster_member_ids
   165→            or item.get("kind") == "synthesis_needed"
   166→        ]
   167→
   168→    return result
   169→
   170→
   171→def _item_matches_tier(item: dict, tier: int) -> bool:
   172→    """Check if an item (or any of its members for clusters) matches a tier."""
   173→    kind = item.get("kind", "")
   174→    if kind in ("synthesis_needed", "epic"):
   175→        return tier == 1  # Always T1
   176→    if kind == "cluster":
   177→        return any(
   178→            int(m.get("effective_tier", m.get("tier", 3))) == tier
   179→            for m in item.get("members", [])
   180→        )
   181→    return int(item.get("effective_tier", item.get("tier", 3))) == tier
   182→
   183→
   184→def _action_type_for_detector(detector: str) -> str:
   185→    """Look up the action_type for a detector from the registry."""
   186→    try:
   187→        from desloppify.core.registry import DETECTORS
   188→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   189→        if meta:
   190→            return meta.action_type
   191→    except ImportError:
   192→        pass
   193→    return "manual_fix"
   194→
   195→
   196→_ACTION_TYPE_PRIORITY = {"auto_fix": 0, "reorganize": 1, "refactor": 2, "manual_fix": 3}
   197→
   198→
   199→def _epic_membership(epics: dict) -> dict[str, str]:
   200→    """Build mapping of finding id to epic name."""
   201→    finding_to_epic: dict[str, str] = {}
   202→    for epic_name, epic in epics.items():
   203→        if epic.get("status") == "completed":
   204→            continue
   205→        for finding_id in epic.get("finding_ids", []):
   206→            finding_to_epic[finding_id] = epic_name
   207→    return finding_to_epic

   209→
   210→def _build_epic_items(plan: dict, state: StateModel) -> list[dict]:
   211→    """Build synthetic queue items for each pending/in_progress epic."""
   212→    epics = plan.get("epics", {})
   213→    if not epics:
   214→        return []
   215→
   216→    total_epics = len(epics)
   217→    items: list[dict] = []
   218→    for epic_name, epic in sorted(
   219→        epics.items(),
   220→        key=lambda kv: kv[1].get("dependency_order", 999),
   221→    ):
   222→        status = epic.get("status", "pending")
   223→        if status == "completed":
   224→            continue
   225→        finding_ids = epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   226→        if not finding_ids:
   227→            continue
   228→
   229→        items.append({
   230→            "id": epic_name,
   231→            "kind": "epic",
   232→            "tier": 1,
   233→            "effective_tier": 1,
   234→            "confidence": "high",
   235→            "detector": "epic",
   236→            "file": ".",
   237→            "summary": f"[{epic.get('direction', 'simplify')}] {epic.get('thesis', '')}",
   238→            "status": "open",
   239→            "primary_command": f"desloppify plan focus {epic_name}",
   240→            "detail": {
   241→                "thesis": epic.get("thesis", ""),
   242→                "direction": epic.get("direction", ""),
   243→                "root_cause": epic.get("root_cause", ""),
   244→                "epic_status": status,
   245→                "agent_safe": epic.get("agent_safe", False),
   246→                "dependency_order": epic.get("dependency_order", 999),
   247→                "total_epics": total_epics,
   248→                "finding_ids": finding_ids,
   249→                "action_steps": epic.get("action_steps", []),
   250→            },
   251→        })
   252→    return items
   253→
   254→
   255→def _inject_synthesis_and_epic_items(
   256→    *,
   257→    all_items: list[dict],
   258→    plan: dict,
   259→    state: StateModel,
   260→    scope: str | None,
   261→) -> None:
   262→    """Inject synthesis::pending and epic items into the queue."""
   263→    existing_ids = {item.get("id") for item in all_items}
   264→
   265→    synthesis_item = build_synthesis_item(plan, state)
   266→    if synthesis_item and synthesis_item["id"] not in existing_ids:
   267→        if scope_matches(synthesis_item, scope):
   268→            all_items.append(synthesis_item)
   269→            existing_ids.add(synthesis_item["id"])
   270→
   271→    epic_items = _build_epic_items(plan, state)
   272→    for item in epic_items:
   273→        if item["id"] not in existing_ids:
   274→            if scope_matches(item, scope):
   275→                all_items.append(item)
   276→                existing_ids.add(item["id"])
   277→
   278→
   279→def _collapse_clusters(items: list[dict], plan: dict) -> list[dict]:
   280→    """Replace cluster member items with single cluster meta-items.
   281→
   282→    Epic membership takes precedence: findings in epics are excluded
   283→    from cluster collapsing (they'll be represented by epic items).
   284→    """
   285→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   286→    epics = plan.get("epics", {})
   287→
   288→    # Build epic membership to exclude from cluster collapse
   289→    epic_finding_ids: set[str] = set()
   290→    if epics:
   291→        for epic in epics.values():
   292→            if epic.get("status") != "completed":
   293→                epic_finding_ids.update(epic.get("finding_ids", []))
   294→
   295→    if not clusters:
   296→        return items
   297→
   298→    # Build mapping: finding_id → auto-cluster name
   299→    fid_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
   300→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   301→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
   302→            continue
   303→        for fid in cluster.get("finding_ids", []):
   304→            fid_to_cluster[fid] = name
   305→
   306→    # Remove epic findings from cluster membership
   307→    for fid in epic_finding_ids:
   308→        fid_to_cluster.pop(fid, None)
   309→
   310→    if not fid_to_cluster:
   311→        return items
   312→
   313→    # Collect members for each cluster, preserving order
   314→    cluster_members: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
   315→    non_cluster_items: list[dict] = []
   316→
   317→    for item in items:
   318→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   319→        if cname:
   320→            cluster_members.setdefault(cname, []).append(item)
   321→        else:
   322→            non_cluster_items.append(item)
   323→
   324→    # Build cluster meta-items
   325→    result: list[dict] = list(non_cluster_items)
   326→    for cname, members in cluster_members.items():
   327→        # Don't collapse singletons — show them as individual findings
   328→        if len(members) < 2:
   329→            result.extend(members)
   330→            continue
   331→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cname, {})
   332→        detector = members[0].get("detector", "") if members else ""
   333→        action = cluster_data.get("action") or ""
   334→        # Derive action_type from the actual cluster action, not just the detector
   335→        if "desloppify fix" in action:
   336→            action_type = "auto_fix"
   337→        elif "desloppify move" in action:
   338→            action_type = "reorganize"
   339→        else:
   340→            action_type = _action_type_for_detector(detector)
   341→            # If detector says auto_fix but cluster has no fix command, it's really refactor
   342→            if action_type == "auto_fix" and "desloppify fix" not in action:
   343→                action_type = "refactor"
   344→
   345→        # Use stored description but patch the count if it differs from visible members
   346→        stored_desc = cluster_data.get("description") or ""
   347→        total_in_cluster = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   348→        if stored_desc and total_in_cluster != len(members):
   349→            # Replace the stored count with the visible count
   350→            summary = stored_desc.replace(str(total_in_cluster), str(len(members)))
   351→        else:
   352→            summary = stored_desc or f"{len(members)} findings"
   353→
   354→        primary_command = cluster_data.get("action")
   355→        if not primary_command:
   356→            primary_command = f"desloppify next --cluster {cname} --count 10"
   357→
   358→        meta_item: dict = {
   359→            "id": cname,
   360→            "kind": "cluster",
   361→            "action_type": action_type,
   362→            "summary": summary,
   363→            "members": members,
   364→            "member_count": len(members),
   365→            "primary_command": primary_command,
   366→            "cluster_name": cname,
   367→            "cluster_auto": True,
   368→            "confidence": "high",
   369→            "detector": detector,
   370→            "file": "",
   371→        }
   372→        result.append(meta_item)
   373→
   374→    result.sort(key=item_sort_key)
   375→    return result
   376→
   377→
   378→def build_work_queue(
   379→    state: StateModel,
   380→    *,
   381→    options: QueueBuildOptions | None = None,
   382→) -> WorkQueueResult:
   383→    """Build ranked queue items + tier metadata."""
   384→    resolved_options = options or QueueBuildOptions()
   385→
   386→    status = resolved_options.status
   387→    if status not in ALL_STATUSES:
   388→        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported status filter: {status}")
   389→    try:
   390→        subjective_threshold_value = float(resolved_options.subjective_threshold)
   391→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   392→        subjective_threshold_value = 100.0
   393→    subjective_threshold_value = max(0.0, min(100.0, subjective_threshold_value))
   394→
   395→    finding_items = build_finding_items(
   396→        state,
   397→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
   398→        status_filter=status,
   399→        scope=resolved_options.scope,
   400→        chronic=resolved_options.chronic,
   401→    )
   402→
   403→    all_items = list(finding_items)
   404→    if (
   405→        resolved_options.include_subjective
   406→        and status in {"open", "all"}
   407→        and not resolved_options.chronic
   408→    ):
   409→        subjective_items = build_subjective_items(
   410→            state,
   411→            state.get("findings", {}),
   412→            threshold=subjective_threshold_value,
   413→        )
   414→        for item in subjective_items:
   415→            if scope_matches(item, resolved_options.scope):
   416→                all_items.append(item)
   417→
   418→    # Inject synthesis::pending and epic items when plan has them
   419→    if resolved_options.plan:
   420→        _inject_synthesis_and_epic_items(
   421→            all_items=all_items,
   422→            plan=resolved_options.plan,
   423→            state=state,
   424→            scope=resolved_options.scope,
   425→        )
   426→
   427→    all_items.sort(key=item_sort_key)
   428→
   429→    # Apply living plan ordering if provided
   430→    if resolved_options.plan:
   431→        all_items = _apply_plan_order(
   432→            all_items,
   433→            resolved_options.plan,
   434→            include_skipped=resolved_options.include_skipped,
   435→            cluster=resolved_options.cluster,
   436→            state=state if resolved_options.include_skipped else None,
   437→        )
   438→
   439→    # Collapse auto-clusters into meta-items (unless drilling into a cluster)
   440→    should_collapse = (
   441→        resolved_options.collapse_clusters
   442→        and resolved_options.plan
   443→        and not resolved_options.cluster
   444→        and not resolved_options.plan.get("active_cluster")
   445→    )
   446→    if should_collapse:
   447→        all_items = _collapse_clusters(all_items, resolved_options.plan)
   448→
   449→    counts = tier_counts(all_items)
   450→
   451→    requested_tier = (
   452→        int(resolved_options.tier) if resolved_options.tier is not None else None
   453→    )
   454→    selected_tier = requested_tier
   455→    fallback_reason = None
   456→    filtered = all_items
   457→
   458→    if requested_tier is not None:
   459→        filtered = [
   460→            item
   461→            for item in all_items
   462→            if _item_matches_tier(item, requested_tier)
   463→        ]
   464→        if not filtered and not resolved_options.no_tier_fallback:
   465→            chosen = choose_fallback_tier(requested_tier, counts)
   466→            if chosen is not None:
   467→                selected_tier = chosen
   468→                filtered = [
   469→                    item
   470→                    for item in all_items
   471→                    if _item_matches_tier(item, chosen)
   472→                ]
   473→                fallback_reason = (
   474→                    f"Requested T{requested_tier} has 0 open -> showing T{chosen} "
   475→                    "(nearest non-empty)."
   476→                )
   477→        elif not filtered:
   478→            fallback_reason = f"Requested T{requested_tier} has 0 open."
   479→
   480→    total = len(filtered)
   481→    if resolved_options.count is not None and resolved_options.count > 0:
   482→        filtered = filtered[: resolved_options.count]
   483→
   484→    if resolved_options.explain:
   485→        for item in filtered:
   486→            item["explain"] = item_explain(item)
   487→
   488→    available_tiers = [tier for tier, value in counts.items() if value > 0]
   489→    return {
   490→        "items": filtered,
   491→        "total": total,
   492→        "tier_counts": counts,
   493→        "requested_tier": requested_tier,
   494→        "selected_tier": selected_tier,
   495→        "fallback_reason": fallback_reason,
   496→        "available_tiers": available_tiers,
   497→        "grouped": group_queue_items(filtered, "item"),
   498→    }
   499→

   132→_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   133→You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Your goal is to produce
   134→a coherent, prioritized strategy to address ALL open review findings.
   135→
   136→Your plan should:
   137→- Cluster findings by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
   138→- Give each cluster (epic) a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   139→- Order epics by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense

   150→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   151→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   152→- `desloppify plan done <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   153→- `desloppify plan move <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   154→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   155→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   156→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review findings
   157→
   158→Your output defines the ENTIRE work plan. Findings not assigned to any epic

   162→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:

   223→    # Section: all open review findings
   224→    parts.append(f"## All open review findings ({len(si.open_findings)})")
   225→    for fid, f in sorted(si.open_findings.items()):
   226→        detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   227→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   228→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   229→        confidence = f.get("confidence", "medium")
   230→        file_path = f.get("file", "")
   231→        summary = f.get("summary", "")
   232→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {fid}")
   233→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   234→        if dimension:
   235→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   236→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   237→        if suggestion:
   238→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   239→    parts.append("")
   240→
   241→    # Section: dimension scores for context
   242→    if si.dimension_scores:
   243→        parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   244→        for name, data in sorted(si.dimension_scores.items()):
   245→            if isinstance(data, dict):
   246→                score = data.get("score", "?")
   247→                strict = data.get("strict", score)
   248→                issues = data.get("issues", 0)
   249→                parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   250→        parts.append("")
   251→
   252→    # Section: previously dismissed
   253→    if si.previously_dismissed:
   254→        parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(si.previously_dismissed)})")
   255→        parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   256→        for fid in si.previously_dismissed:
   257→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   258→        parts.append("")
   259→
   260→    return "\n".join(parts)
   261→
   262→
   263→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   264→# Result parsing
   265→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   266→
   267→def parse_synthesis_result(raw: dict, valid_ids: set[str]) -> SynthesisResult:
   268→    """Parse and validate raw LLM output into a SynthesisResult.
   269→
   270→    Invalid finding IDs are silently dropped from epics and dismissals.
   271→    """
   272→    strategy_summary = str(raw.get("strategy_summary", ""))
   273→
   274→    epics: list[dict] = []
   275→    for raw_epic in raw.get("epics", []):
   276→        if not isinstance(raw_epic, dict):
   277→            continue
   278→        name = str(raw_epic.get("name", "")).strip()
   279→        if not name:
   280→            continue
   281→        # Validate direction
   282→        direction = str(raw_epic.get("direction", "simplify")).strip()
   283→        if direction not in VALID_EPIC_DIRECTIONS:
   284→            direction = "simplify"
   285→        # Filter to valid finding IDs
   286→        finding_ids = [
   287→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   288→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   289→        ]
   290→        dismissed = [
   291→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("dismissed", [])
   292→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   293→        ]
   294→        action_steps = [
   295→            str(s) for s in raw_epic.get("action_steps", [])
   296→            if isinstance(s, str)
   297→        ]
   298→
   299→        epics.append({
   300→            "name": name,
   301→            "thesis": str(raw_epic.get("thesis", "")),
   302→            "direction": direction,
   303→            "root_cause": str(raw_epic.get("root_cause", "")),
   304→            "finding_ids": finding_ids,
   305→            "dismissed": dismissed,
   306→            "agent_safe": bool(raw_epic.get("agent_safe", False)),
   307→            "dependency_order": int(raw_epic.get("dependency_order", 999)),
   308→            "action_steps": action_steps,
   309→            "status": str(raw_epic.get("status", "pending")),
   310→        })
   311→
   312→    dismissed_findings: list[DismissedFinding] = []
   313→    for d in raw.get("dismissed_findings", []):
   314→        if not isinstance(d, dict):
   315→            continue
   316→        fid = str(d.get("finding_id", ""))
   317→        if fid in valid_ids:
   318→            dismissed_findings.append(
   319→                DismissedFinding(finding_id=fid, reason=str(d.get("reason", "")))
   320→            )
   321→
   322→    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = []
   323→    for c in raw.get("contradiction_notes", []):
   324→        if not isinstance(c, dict):
   325→            continue
   326→        contradiction_notes.append(ContradictionNote(
   327→            kept=str(c.get("kept", "")),
   328→            dismissed=str(c.get("dismissed", "")),
   329→            reason=str(c.get("reason", "")),
   330→        ))
   331→
   332→    priority_rationale = str(raw.get("priority_rationale", ""))
   333→
   334→    return SynthesisResult(
   335→        strategy_summary=strategy_summary,
   336→        epics=epics,
   337→        dismissed_findings=dismissed_findings,
   338→        contradiction_notes=contradiction_notes,
   339→        priority_rationale=priority_rationale,
   340→    )
   341→
   342→
   343→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   344→# Plan mutation
   345→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   346→
   347→def apply_synthesis_to_plan(
   348→    plan: PlanModel,
   349→    state: StateModel,
   350→    synthesis: SynthesisResult,
   351→    *,
   352→    trigger: str = "manual",
   353→) -> SynthesisMutationResult:
   354→    """Apply parsed synthesis result to the living plan.
   355→
   356→    1. Creates/updates epic entries in plan["epics"]
   357→    2. Marks dismissed findings as synthesized_out skips
   358→    3. Reorders queue_order to group epic members by dependency_order
   359→    4. Updates epic_synthesis_meta with snapshot hash
   360→    """
   361→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   362→    now = utc_now()
   363→    result = SynthesisMutationResult()
   364→    result.strategy_summary = synthesis.strategy_summary
   365→
   366→    epics = plan["epics"]
   367→    skipped: dict = plan["skipped"]
   368→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   369→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   370→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   371→    result.synthesis_version = version
   372→
   373→    # --- Update/create epics ------------------------------------------------
   374→    seen_epic_names: set[str] = set()
   375→    for epic_data in sorted(synthesis.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   376→        raw_name = epic_data["name"]
   377→        epic_name = f"{EPIC_PREFIX}{raw_name}" if not raw_name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX) else raw_name
   378→        seen_epic_names.add(epic_name)
   379→
   380→        existing = epics.get(epic_name)
   381→        if existing:
   382→            # Update existing epic
   383→            existing["thesis"] = epic_data["thesis"]
   384→            existing["direction"] = epic_data["direction"]
   385→            existing["root_cause"] = epic_data.get("root_cause", "")
   386→            existing["finding_ids"] = epic_data["finding_ids"]
   387→            existing["dismissed"] = epic_data.get("dismissed", [])
   388→            existing["agent_safe"] = epic_data.get("agent_safe", False)
   389→            existing["dependency_order"] = epic_data["dependency_order"]
   390→            existing["action_steps"] = epic_data.get("action_steps", [])
   391→            existing["updated_at"] = now
   392→            existing["synthesis_version"] = version
   393→            # Don't overwrite in_progress status from agent
   394→            if existing.get("status") != "in_progress":
   395→                existing["status"] = epic_data.get("status", "pending")
   396→            result.epics_updated += 1
   397→        else:
   398→            # Create new epic
   399→            epic: Epic = {
   400→                "name": epic_name,
   401→                "thesis": epic_data["thesis"],
   402→                "direction": epic_data["direction"],
   403→                "root_cause": epic_data.get("root_cause", ""),
   404→                "finding_ids": epic_data["finding_ids"],
   405→                "supersedes": [],
   406→                "dismissed": epic_data.get("dismissed", []),
   407→                "agent_safe": epic_data.get("agent_safe", False),
   408→                "dependency_order": epic_data["dependency_order"],
   409→                "action_steps": epic_data.get("action_steps", []),
   410→                "source_clusters": [],
   411→                "status": epic_data.get("status", "pending"),
   412→                "created_at": now,
   413→                "updated_at": now,
   414→                "synthesis_version": version,
   415→                "auto": True,
   416→            }
   417→            epics[epic_name] = epic
   418→            result.epics_created += 1
   419→
   420→    # --- Dismiss findings ---------------------------------------------------
   421→    dismissed_ids: list[str] = []
   422→    for df in synthesis.dismissed_findings:
   423→        fid = df.finding_id
   424→        dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   425→        # Remove from queue, add to skipped as synthesized_out
   426→        if fid in order:
   427→            order.remove(fid)
   428→        skipped[fid] = {
   429→            "finding_id": fid,
   430→            "kind": "synthesized_out",
   431→            "reason": df.reason,
   432→            "note": f"Dismissed by epic synthesis v{version}",
   433→            "attestation": None,
   434→            "created_at": now,
   435→            "review_after": None,
   436→            "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   437→        }
   438→        result.findings_dismissed += 1
   439→
   440→    # Also handle per-epic dismissed lists
   441→    for epic_data in synthesis.epics:
   442→        for fid in epic_data.get("dismissed", []):
   443→            if fid not in dismissed_ids and fid in order:
   444→                order.remove(fid)
   445→                dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   446→                skipped[fid] = {
   447→                    "finding_id": fid,
   448→                    "kind": "synthesized_out",
   449→                    "reason": f"Dismissed by epic synthesis v{version}",
   450→                    "note": None,
   451→                    "attestation": None,
   452→                    "created_at": now,
   453→                    "review_after": None,
   454→                    "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   455→                }
   456→                result.findings_dismissed += 1
   457→
   458→    # --- Reorder queue: epic findings grouped by dependency_order -----------
   459→    epic_finding_ids: set[str] = set()
   460→    epic_ordered_ids: list[str] = []
   461→    for epic_data in sorted(synthesis.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   462→        for fid in epic_data["finding_ids"]:
   463→            if fid not in epic_finding_ids and fid not in dismissed_ids:
   464→                epic_finding_ids.add(fid)
   465→                epic_ordered_ids.append(fid)
   466→
   467→    # Rebuild order: epic items first (by dependency), then non-epic items in original order
   468→    non_epic_items = [fid for fid in order if fid not in epic_finding_ids]
   469→    # Insert epic items at the front (after synthesis::pending if present)
   470→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import SYNTHESIS_ID
   471→    new_order: list[str] = []
   472→    # Keep synthesis::pending at front if present (it will be pruned next sync)
   473→    if SYNTHESIS_ID in non_epic_items:
   474→        non_epic_items.remove(SYNTHESIS_ID)
   475→    new_order.extend(epic_ordered_ids)
   476→    new_order.extend(non_epic_items)
   477→    order.clear()
   478→    order.extend(new_order)
   479→
   480→    # --- Update synthesis meta -----------------------------------------------
   481→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   482→    open_review_ids = sorted(
   483→        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   484→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   485→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   486→    )
   487→
   488→    plan["epic_synthesis_meta"] = {
   489→        "synthesized_ids": open_review_ids,
   490→        "last_run": now,
   491→        "version": version,
   492→        "dismissed_ids": dismissed_ids,
   493→        "finding_snapshot_hash": current_hash,
   494→        "strategy_summary": synthesis.strategy_summary,
   495→        "trigger": trigger,
   496→    }
   497→    plan["updated"] = now
   498→
   499→    return result
   500→
   501→
   502→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   503→# Top-level orchestrator
   504→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   505→
   506→@dataclass
   507→class SynthesisDeps:
   508→    """Injectable dependencies for the synthesis engine."""
   509→
   510→    llm_call: Any = None  # Callable[[str, str], str] — (system, user) -> response
   511→
   512→
   513→def synthesize_epics(
   514→    plan: PlanModel,
   515→    state: StateModel,
   516→    *,
   517→    deps: SynthesisDeps | None = None,
   518→    dry_run: bool = False,
   519→    trigger: str = "manual",
   520→) -> SynthesisMutationResult:
   521→    """Run epic synthesis: collect input, call LLM, apply results.
   522→
   523→    If ``dry_run`` is True, collects input and builds prompt but does not
   524→    call the LLM or mutate the plan.
   525→
   526→    If ``deps.llm_call`` is None, returns a dry-run result with the prompt.
   527→    """
   528→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   529→    si = collect_synthesis_input(plan, state)
   530→
   531→    prompt = build_synthesis_prompt(si)
   532→    valid_ids = set(si.open_findings.keys())
   533→
   534→    if dry_run or deps is None or deps.llm_call is None:
   535→        result = SynthesisMutationResult(dry_run=True)
   536→        result.strategy_summary = f"[dry-run] Prompt built with {len(si.open_findings)} findings"
   537→        return result
   538→
   539→    # Call LLM
   540→    try:
   541→        raw_response = deps.llm_call(_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
   542→        raw_json = json.loads(raw_response)
   543→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   544→        logger.error("Epic synthesis LLM response parse error: %s", exc)
   545→        result = SynthesisMutationResult()
   546→        result.strategy_summary = f"Synthesis failed: {exc}"
   547→        return result
   548→
   549→    synthesis = parse_synthesis_result(raw_json, valid_ids)
   550→    return apply_synthesis_to_plan(plan, state, synthesis, trigger=trigger)
   551→
   552→
   553→__all__ = [
   554→    "DismissedFinding",
   555→    "SynthesisDeps",
   556→    "SynthesisInput",
   557→    "SynthesisMutationResult",
   558→    "SynthesisResult",
   559→    "apply_synthesis_to_plan",
   560→    "build_synthesis_prompt",
   561→    "collect_synthesis_input",
   562→    "parse_synthesis_result",
   563→    "synthesize_epics",
   564→]
   565→

1→"""Post-scan plan reconciliation — handle finding churn."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from dataclasses import dataclass, field
     6→from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
     7→
     8→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import PlanModel, SupersededEntry, ensure_plan_defaults
     9→from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX, SYNTHESIS_ID
    10→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel, utc_now
    11→
    12→
    13→SUPERSEDED_TTL_DAYS = 90
    14→
    15→
    16→@dataclass
    17→class ReconcileResult:
    18→    """Summary of changes made during reconciliation."""
    19→
    20→    superseded: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    21→    pruned: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    22→    resurfaced: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    23→    changes: int = 0
    24→
    25→
    26→def _find_candidates(
    27→    state: StateModel, detector: str, file: str
    28→) -> list[str]:
    29→    """Find open findings that could be remaps for a disappeared finding."""
    30→    candidates: list[str] = []
    31→    for fid, finding in state.get("findings", {}).items():
    32→        if finding.get("status") != "open":
    33→            continue
    34→        if finding.get("detector") == detector and finding.get("file") == file:
    35→            candidates.append(fid)
    36→    return candidates
    37→
    38→
    39→def _is_finding_alive(state: StateModel, finding_id: str) -> bool:
    40→    """Return True if the finding exists and is open."""
    41→    finding = state.get("findings", {}).get(finding_id)
    42→    if finding is None:
    43→        return False
    44→    return finding.get("status") == "open"
    45→
    46→
    47→def _supersede_id(
    48→    plan: PlanModel,
    49→    state: StateModel,
    50→    finding_id: str,
    51→    now: str,
    52→) -> bool:
    53→    """Move a disappeared finding to superseded. Returns True if changed."""
    54→    finding = state.get("findings", {}).get(finding_id)
    55→    detector = ""
    56→    file = ""
    57→    summary = ""
    58→    if finding:
    59→        detector = finding.get("detector", "")
    60→        file = finding.get("file", "")
    61→        summary = finding.get("summary", "")
    62→
    63→    candidates = _find_candidates(state, detector, file) if detector else []
    64→    # Don't include the original in candidates
    65→    candidates = [c for c in candidates if c != finding_id]
    66→
    67→    entry: SupersededEntry = {
    68→        "original_id": finding_id,
    69→        "original_detector": detector,
    70→        "original_file": file,
    71→        "original_summary": summary,
    72→        "status": "superseded",
    73→        "superseded_at": now,
    74→        "remapped_to": None,
    75→        "candidates": candidates[:5],
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    # Preserve any existing override note
    79→    override = plan.get("overrides", {}).get(finding_id)
    80→    if override and override.get("note"):
    81→        entry["note"] = override["note"]
    82→
    83→    plan["superseded"][finding_id] = entry
    84→
    85→    # Remove from queue_order, skipped, cluster finding_ids
    86→    order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    87→    skipped: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
    88→    if finding_id in order:
    89→        order.remove(finding_id)
    90→    skipped.pop(finding_id, None)
    91→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
    92→        ids = cluster.get("finding_ids", [])
    93→        if finding_id in ids:
    94→            ids.remove(finding_id)
    95→
    96→    return True
    97→
    98→
    99→def _prune_old_superseded(plan: PlanModel, now_dt: datetime) -> list[str]:
   100→    """Remove superseded entries older than TTL. Returns pruned IDs."""
   101→    superseded = plan.get("superseded", {})
   102→    cutoff = now_dt - timedelta(days=SUPERSEDED_TTL_DAYS)
   103→    to_prune: list[str] = []
   104→
   105→    for fid, entry in superseded.items():
   106→        ts = entry.get("superseded_at", "")
   107→        try:
   108→            entry_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(ts)
   109→            if entry_dt.tzinfo is None:
   110→                entry_dt = entry_dt.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
   111→            if entry_dt < cutoff:
   112→                to_prune.append(fid)
   113→        except (ValueError, TypeError):
   114→            to_prune.append(fid)
   115→
   116→    for fid in to_prune:
   117→        superseded.pop(fid, None)
   118→        # Also clean up stale overrides
   119→        plan.get("overrides", {}).pop(fid, None)
   120→
   121→    return to_prune
   122→
   123→
   124→def reconcile_plan_after_scan(
   125→    plan: PlanModel,
   126→    state: StateModel,
   127→) -> ReconcileResult:
   128→    """Reconcile plan against current state after a scan.
   129→
   130→    Finds IDs referenced in the plan that no longer exist or are no longer
   131→    open, moves them to superseded, and prunes old superseded entries.
   132→    """
   133→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   134→    result = ReconcileResult()
   135→    now = utc_now()
   136→    now_dt = datetime.now(UTC)
   137→
   138→    # Collect all finding IDs referenced by the plan
   139→    referenced_ids: set[str] = set()
   140→    referenced_ids.update(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   141→    referenced_ids.update(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   142→    for override_id in plan.get("overrides", {}):
   143→        referenced_ids.add(override_id)
   144→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   145→        referenced_ids.update(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   146→    # Include epic finding_ids and dismissed lists
   147→    for epic in plan.get("epics", {}).values():
   148→        referenced_ids.update(epic.get("finding_ids", []))
   149→        referenced_ids.update(epic.get("dismissed", []))
   150→

     4→
     5→- **sync_unscored_dimensions** — prepend never-scored (placeholder) dimensions
     6→  to the *front* of the queue unconditionally (onboarding priority).

     8→  the *back* of the queue when no objective items remain.

    55→def _current_stale_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    56→    """Return the set of ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are currently stale."""
    57→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
    58→    from desloppify.engine.planning.scorecard_projection import (
    59→        scorecard_subjective_entries,
    60→    )
    61→
    62→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
    63→    if not dim_scores:
    64→        return set()
    65→
    66→    stale: set[str] = set()
    67→    for entry in scorecard_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores):
    68→        if not entry.get("stale"):
    69→            continue
    70→        dim_key = entry.get("dimension_key", "")
    71→        if dim_key:
    72→            stale.add(f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}")
    73→    return stale
    74→
    75→
    76→def _current_unscored_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    77→    """Return the set of ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are currently unscored (placeholder).
    78→
    79→    Checks ``subjective_assessments`` directly because
    80→    ``scorecard_subjective_entries`` filters out placeholder dimensions
    81→    (they are hidden from the scorecard display).
    82→    """
    83→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
    84→
    85→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments")
    86→    if not isinstance(assessments, dict) or not assessments:
    87→        return set()
    88→
    89→    unscored: set[str] = set()
    90→    for dim_key, payload in assessments.items():
    91→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
    92→            continue
    93→        if not payload.get("placeholder"):
    94→            continue
    95→        if dim_key:
    96→            unscored.add(f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}")
    97→    return unscored
    98→
    99→
   100→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    11→def print_agent_plan(

    35→def _print_plan_agent_block(plan: dict, *, header: str = "  AGENT PLAN:") -> None:
    36→    """Render the living plan as the agent plan block."""

    43→    if active:

    45→        remaining = len(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
    46→        print(colorize(f"  Focused on: {active} ({remaining} items remaining).", "dim"))
    47→    epics = plan.get("epics", {})
    48→    if epics:
    49→        active_epics = sum(1 for e in epics.values() if e.get("status") != "completed")
    50→        print(colorize(f"  Epics: {len(epics)} ({active_epics} active).", "dim"))
    51→        meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
    52→        strategy = meta.get("strategy_summary", "")
    53→        if strategy:
    54→            short = strategy.split(".")[0] + "." if "." in strategy else strategy
    55→            print(colorize(f"  Strategy: {short}", "dim"))
    56→    print(colorize("  Next command: `desloppify next`", "dim"))
    57→    print(colorize("  View plan: `desloppify plan`", "dim"))

    76→
    77→def print_ranked_actions(
    78→    actions: list[dict], *, limit: int = 3, plan: dict | None = None
    79→) -> bool:
    80→    """Print the highest-impact narrative actions and return True when shown."""
    81→    ranked = sorted(
    82→        [action for action in actions if int(action.get("count", 0)) > 0],
    83→        key=lambda action: (
    84→            -float(action.get("impact", 0.0)),
    85→            -int(action.get("count", 0)),
    86→            int(action.get("priority", 999)),
    87→        ),
    88→    )
    89→    if not ranked:
    90→        return False
    91→    has_plan = plan and (plan.get("queue_order") or plan.get("clusters"))
    92→    label = "Score context:" if has_plan else "Biggest things impacting score:"
    93→    print(colorize(f"  {label}", "cyan"))
    94→    for action in ranked[:limit]:
    95→        detector = action.get("detector", "unknown")
    96→        count = int(action.get("count", 0))
    97→        cluster_count = action.get("cluster_count")
    98→        if cluster_count:
    99→            print(colorize(f"    - {detector}: {count} open in {cluster_count} cluster(s) — `desloppify next`", "dim"))
   100→        else:
   101→            command = action.get("command", "desloppify next")
   102→            print(colorize(f"    - {detector}: {count} open — `{command}`", "dim"))
   103→    return True
   104→
   105→
   106→__all__ = [
   107→    "print_agent_plan",
   108→    "print_ranked_actions",
   109→    "print_replacement_groups",

414→def set_focus(plan: PlanModel, cluster_name: str) -> None:
   415→    """Set the active cluster focus.
   416→
   417→    Supports epic/ names — creates a transient cluster entry so the
   418→    queue filter can match epic finding_ids.
   419→    """
   420→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   421→    if cluster_name.startswith("epic/"):
   422→        epics = plan.get("epics", {})
   423→        if cluster_name not in epics:
   424→            raise ValueError(f"Epic {cluster_name!r} does not exist")
   425→        epic = epics[cluster_name]
   426→        # Create transient cluster entry for queue filtering
   427→        plan["clusters"][cluster_name] = {
   428→            "name": cluster_name,
   429→            "description": epic.get("thesis", ""),
   430→            "finding_ids": list(epic.get("finding_ids", [])),
   431→            "auto": True,
   432→            "cluster_key": f"epic::{cluster_name}",
   433→            "action": f"desloppify plan focus {cluster_name}",
   434→            "user_modified": False,
   435→        }
   436→        plan["active_cluster"] = cluster_name
   437→        return
   438→    if cluster_name not in plan["clusters"]:
   439→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {cluster_name!r} does not exist")
   440→    plan["active_cluster"] = cluster_name
   441→
   442→
   443→def clear_focus(plan: PlanModel) -> None:
   444→    """Clear the active cluster focus."""
   445→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   446→    plan["active_cluster"] = None
   447→
   448→
   449→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   450→# Reset
   451→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   452→
   453→def reset_plan(plan: PlanModel) -> None:
   454→    """Reset plan to empty state, preserving version and created timestamp."""
   455→    created = plan.get("created", utc_now())
   456→    plan.clear()
   457→    from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import empty_plan as _empty
   458→    for k, v in _empty().items():
   459→        plan[k] = v
   460→    plan["created"] = created
   461→
   462→
   463→def purge_ids(plan: PlanModel, finding_ids: list[str]) -> int:
   464→    """Remove finding IDs from the plan entirely.
   465→
   466→    Cleans queue_order, skipped, and all cluster memberships.
   467→    Does NOT touch overrides (descriptions/notes are kept for history).
   468→    Returns count of IDs that were actually present somewhere.
   469→    """
   470→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   471→    found = 0
   472→
   473→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   474→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
   475→    for fid in finding_ids:
   476→        was_present = False
   477→        if fid in order:
   478→            order.remove(fid)
   479→            was_present = True
   480→        if fid in skipped:
   481→            skipped.pop(fid)
   482→            was_present = True
   483→        for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   484→            ids = cluster.get("finding_ids", [])
   485→            if fid in ids:
   486→                ids.remove(fid)
   487→                was_present = True
   488→        if was_present:
   489→            found += 1
   490→
   491→    return found
   492→
   493→

   495→    "add_to_cluster",
